analyst_view.overall: Early view: Vitória are 14th on 9 points but pushed unbeaten leaders Porto hard, losing 2-1 to an 86th-minute goal, while Estrela have lost five in a row under Pepa. Toni Borevkovic is listed by the brief with a fifth-yellow ban, and he also suffered a head injury with concussion protocol against Porto, so he looks out. Vitória play Braga in the Taça de Portugal on 22 November, which could take a toll six days before this game.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. The two sides pull in opposite directions: Vitória's games are tight (23 goals in 11, including a 0-0 at Gil Vicente), while Estrela's are wild (39 in 11, including 3-3 with Rio Ave and 2-3 with Benfica). That balance sits close to the site's figure.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, 5.9 for Vitória. I lean higher: Estrela took just one corner and conceded ten at home to Benfica, and they sit deep when behind. Vitória at home, needing a win, should pile up set pieces.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.9 cards. I lean higher: Record described Vitória's 0-0 at Gil Vicente as a game of many fouls, and both clubs are under pressure in the lower half. Pepa has clashed with officials this season, and Estrela left out Eddy Doué and Beni Souza for failing team commitments.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.7 shots, with Vitória taking most. Estrela only managed 7 shots against Benfica, but Vitória's attack is not prolific either (11 goals in 11). I stay near the site's figure.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.6 shots on target. Vitória rely on narrow margins and Record noted a scoring drought for Estrela's front three of Marcus, Stoica and Antonetti, even if Antonetti scored against Benfica. I lean slightly lower.
